title: Chapter 216 Controlling The Management Of The Territory
content:
Chapter 216 Controlling The Management Of The Territory

This time, Wu Qing was not going to whet Gou Bao's appetite, and he lifted the quantity limit on the Zerg biological equipment trading.

In the end, the Tengu tribe used a large number of luck beads to purchase 100,000 sets of Zerg biological equipment from Wu Qing, plus the 10,000 sets compensated by Wu Qing, a total of 110,000 sets of Zerg biological equipment were to be taken back.

This time, Gou Bao became the person with the most Zerg biological equipment.

The Tengu tribe announced that the Zerg used 110,000 sets of powerful equipment in exchange for their territory in this area.

This was a passable step, and Wu Qing also acquiesced to their statement.

…

The matter of the Tengu tribe's territory was peacefully resolved, and the Zerg finally took over a piece of land recognized by all forces in this world.

Next, Wu Qing should consider how to receive these territories and how to manage them.

With Naga's thoughtful arrangements, the Naga tribe's territory only needs to send a small number of Zerg puppies to station there, temporarily maintaining the status quo, and does not need to spend too much thought.

There are still some unstable factors in the Tengu territory. Wu Qing has sent a large number of Zerg hosts to float over each city and keep an eye on it. They can temporarily not enter the border. When the Tengu withdraw, they must give priority to receiving these cities.

The most important task of the Zerg now is to wipe out the remaining demon army and rescue the population of the demon territory.

A Zerg army composed entirely of Zerg puppies entered the demon territory from the original bear goblin territory and rushed to a demon territory city under the guidance of the Zerg host.

The cities in the demon territory are basically divided into two parts, one is the demon castle and the other is the gathering place of the people.

The army and managers of the demon tribe live in the castle, while ordinary people live in the dirty and messy gathering place.

This kind of city layout facilitates the attack of the Zerg army.

The living places of ordinary people do not even have the most basic city walls, and are scattered around the demon castle.

The Zerg puppies rushed past the numb ordinary citizens, killed the demon supervisors, and headed for the demon castle through the road made by the ordinary citizens.

The demon army, even if it was just a small group of inferior demons, adhered to the principle of "not letting the enemy enter the castle until they die", and lined up under the castle.

The Zerg puppies were powerful, and they were already the ceiling among the non-star soldiers. They killed the few inferior demons with just one charge.

The Zerg puppies rushed into the demon castle, cleaned up all the demons, collected the fire energy crystals together, and rushed to the next target.

In the captured territory, only one Zerg host and a small team of Zerg puppies were left to manage the rescued citizens.

The collected fire energy crystals will be transported away by Zerg transport hosts. The Zerg constantly hatched Zerg puppies, which would consume a lot of system energy resources, and these energy-rich crystals were needed to replenish them.

The Zerg swept across the Demon Tribe's territory from west to east and from south to north, annihilated the remaining Demon Tribe troops, rescued a large number of people, and collected a large number of fire-attribute energy crystals.

In this way, Wu Qing relied on the Zerg dragon group and the main ground forces to attack the castles of the Demon Tribe with certain combat power, relied on a large number of Zerg puppies and Zerg hosts to occupy the territory, and gradually brought the Demon Tribe's territory under the control of the Zerg.

…

In the underground world, the main force of the Zerg army withdrew, leaving only 5,000 Zerg destroyers and Zerg puppies, cooperating with the defense system of the Zerg base to ensure the safety of the Zerg base in the underground world.

The Ghouls have been scared these days, fearing that the Zerg will have some new conspiracy, so they didn't even come to test, and the two sides lived in peace.

With the large amount of resources obtained from the Demon Tribe, plus the large number of luck beads that the Naga and Tengu tribes will deliver, it is enough for Wu Qing to build a powerful main combat force in the Zerg territory.

Wu Qing first replaced the Zerg destroyers that Naga was going to take away, and added 15,000 Zerg destroyers, upgraded 5,000 of them to one-star, and upgraded a small number of two-star and three-star.

The number of Zerg destroyers left in the Zerg increased to over 20,000, which was enough to support the Zerg's operations in the underground world for the time being.

Wu Qing was going to continue to add 200,000 Zerg Hydralisks, 100,000 Zerg Cockroaches and 50,000 Zerg Dragons, and use them as the main force to continue attacking the territory of the Ghoul Clan.

To increase so many troops, it was not enough to rely on the resources obtained by destroying the demon army, and it was also necessary to wait for the luck beads of the Naga Clan and the Tengu Clan.

This time the Tengu Clan acted very quickly, because this was a transaction with a specific quantity, and it was necessary to pay the money and deliver the goods. Under Gou Bao's urging, the luck beads of the Tengu Clan were quickly transported back to the Zerg territory by the Zerg transport host.

The transaction between the Zerg and the Tengu tribe was completed, and the 110,000 general-purpose Zerg biological colonization suits were enough for Gou Bao to deal with.

With the Tengu tribe's luck beads, Wu Qing's newly added Zerg troops of various arms were quickly in place. This Zerg main force immediately went to the underground world and took the initiative to attack the ghoul tribe.

This was a stronger army than the previous Zerg attack force, and launched a fierce attack on the ghoul territory that had been peaceful for a while.

As long as the other main force that cleared the remnants of the demon tribe's territory returned, Wu Qing was ready to launch a general attack on the ghoul tribe.

With the current combat power of the Zerg, if nothing unexpected happens, it is only a matter of time before the ghoul tribe's territory is captured.

…

In order to completely control the vast territory, the number of Zerg puppies is heading towards the goal of tens of millions.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

This number of Zerg puppies is not for fighting, but for controlling the territory. With the Zerg host, the Zerg puppies are really useful.

In the absence of external enemies, a small number of Zerg puppies in conjunction with the Zerg host can completely control a city. The Queen of Zerg can quickly incorporate a city into the Zerg management system by controlling the host.

How to manage these territorial cities is a very important issue, which requires Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg to plan well.

Wu Qing constantly plans territories and populations, and the ultimate goal is still for luck.

The total population of this area controlled by the Zerg is at least tens of millions, mainly the population left over from the Naga and Tengu territories.

Wu Qing does not know how many people the two tribes will take away, but Wu Qing is already clear that the territories of the two tribes are mainly composed of two major populations.

One category is the population living in the cities directly under the two tribes. These cities are basically large and medium-sized cities, and are directly managed by the two tribes.

In these cities, there are not only urban residents, but also personnel and refugees from various other forces.

Once the two tribes evacuate, these cities will become ownerless cities, and the Zerg must go to take over.

The other category is the vassal territories of the two tribes. These vassal territories have their own lords, are self-contained, and are not directly governed by the two tribes.

The situation of these vassal territories is very complicated. Those personnel in the vassal territories with important value will definitely leave with the two tribes. Only those vassal territories that are insignificant to the two tribes will continue to stay here.

In response to these two situations, Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects discussed and finally decided to only take over the cities directly under the two tribes and slowly incorporate them into the management system of Daxia Territory.

Temporarily give up taking over the vassal territories left by the two tribes, incorporate these territories into the management system of the alliance, and make them part of the alliance.

In this way, those territories that were originally vassal states of other races have gained freedom and entered the alliance system, which is better than the Zerg forcibly conquering them.

Vassal territories all have lords, and people's hearts are all kinds of people. Wu Qing has no intention to win them over. As long as they are under the control of the Zerg and can create value for the Zerg, it doesn't matter whether they are directly managed by the Zerg or not.

Giving these vassal territories freedom and allowing them to join the alliance, while strengthening the alliance, it is easy to gain the favor of those lords.

After they are influenced by the alliance and completely return to their hearts, they will discover the superiority of the management system of the Great Xia Territory, and these territories will eventually return to the management system of the Great Xia Territory.

This is a process of self-management for them, and Wu Qing does not need to worry too much. In the management of the territory, Wu Qing is not prepared to invest too much energy.

The development of the Zerg is the focus, and everything else serves this goal.

If the Zerg is strong, everything will be there!

If the Zerg is weak, everything is empty!

The general policy was set, and the remaining details were mainly handled by the Queen of Insects, who could split into countless bodies.

The Great Xia Territory began to issue a recruitment order again. Hu Tu organized people to assess the self-recommended personnel. This time, they mainly recruited management talents.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce really paid attention to the Zerg. The refugees they sent over were of very high quality. After the initial identity registration and authentication, the Queen of Insects counted a large number of useful talents.

These talents are adapting to the new life in the Great Xia Territory, and Wu Qing did not let anyone disturb them.

This recruitment order is very targeted, mainly to give these talents an opportunity to recommend themselves.

Anyone who is willing to serve the Great Xia Territory, has the courage to recommend themselves, and meets some basic standards set by Wu Qing can pass this assessment.

The novel talent selection model of the recruitment order has attracted many people to come for the assessment after vigorous publicity.

A large number of talents of various races successfully passed the assessment and obtained special identity cards.

Bound to the Zerg identity card, they have been exposed to some of the secrets of the Zerg. There are many people with extraordinary knowledge among the talents this time, and they immediately realized the strength of the Zerg.

With these discoveries, they are more excited about the future.

The Queen of Insects uses identity cards to provide efficient one-on-one training to these newly recruited talents. These talents with a certain foundation will soon be able to adapt to the management model of Daxia Territory, and the capable ones among them are qualified to be the lord of a city.
